description:
Full detail for one garment: the variant matrix (colors/sizes/costs), print templates, ApparelHub pricing floor, and quality tier. Read-only.

[#16a079]

product_ref_id.description: The garment ref id from browse_catalog (a string).

provider.description: The fulfillment provider to browse, by name (case-insensitive). Must be a provider this account has access to — call list_catalog_providers to see valid values (the set is account-specific). An unrecognized name returns the list of providers available to the account.

name: get_garment_details
